mapper.insert: insert into sys_work_gen_job (work_id, user_id, status, total, done_count, current_no, current_title, outline, characters, roster, episodes, last_error, create_time, update_time) values (#{workId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{total}, #{doneCount}, #{currentNo}, #{currentTitle}, #{outline}, #{characters}, #{roster}, #{episodes}, #{lastError}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select job_id, work_id, user_id, status, total, done_count, current_no, current_title, outline, characters, roster, episodes, last_error, create_time, update_time from sys_work_gen_job where work_id = #{workId} and job_id = #{jobId}

select job_id, work_id, user_id, status, total, done_count, current_no, current_title, outline, characters, roster, episodes, last_error, create_time, update_time from sys_work_gen_job where work_id = #{workId} order by job_id desc limit 1

select job_id, work_id, user_id, status, total, done_count, current_no, current_title, outline, characters, roster, episodes, last_error, create_time, update_time from sys_work_gen_job where work_id = #{workId} and status in ('queued', 'running') order by job_id desc limit 1

select job_id, work_id, user_id, status, total, done_count, current_no, current_title, outline, characters, roster, episodes, last_error, create_time, update_time from sys_work_gen_job where work_id = #{workId} order by job_id desc limit 20
mapper.update: update sys_work_gen_job set status = #{status}, total = #{total}, done_count = #{doneCount}, current_no = #{currentNo}, current_title = #{currentTitle}, episodes = #{episodes}, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = now() where job_id = #{jobId}
